structures.what: the source's vine trap field (vines, pustule, bones, gas traps, a strongbox)
structures.why: a friendly weir camp; its dangers name no trap; the treasure is the thief's sack

structures.what: gas traps and a gas fissure
Hist roots and a root-worm tunnel mouth in the marsh to the south-west
structures.why: an ordinary part of the marsh round a Hist-keeping camp; no building

plan.source: The allocated source is already the camp near Loreisian (King of the Murkmire cluster -29,-29, camp-tribal, rank 2 of the card): the closest of the ranked sources to a two-warden camp of hide tents on platforms (Hunters Rest is a Nordic homestead, Ree-An-Wo a 31-building hamlet, Black Rose a ruin hamlet), so no switch is needed. Its ruin columns, busts, beacons and trap field are dropped; the tents on platforms, weir, log walk, moss, landing and Hist-shoot post are added from the pool.

gives.by: Skyrim's deep-pond fish spawner in the pool below the woven weir (draft.add), the weir's eel and gar traps
King of the Murkmire's cooking pot by the landing (draft.add; place.json stations)
quest 2's own placements at a fixed level in quests.jsonl: two mudcrabs on the bank and two young crocodiles below the weir
the Thief's Sack hidden in the reeds at the waterline east of the weir (draft.add), stocked at T1
three hanks of hanging moss (Sithis' beard) seated on the woven weir's fences (draft.add need 0), and the quest's own hank beside them
